newsitem.title: CHINA: China Construction Bank limits branch managers.
newsitem.headline: China Construction Bank limits branch managers.

text.p: The China Construction Bank has taken another step toward becoming a real commercial bank by regulating the power limits for branch presidents at the provincial level, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Bank president Wang Qishan had distributed "authorisation certificates" to 45 provincial branch presidents on Thursday limiting their powers over business operations and personnel management, it said.
"Financial risks are increasing for commercial banks now, and only an effective managerial system can prevent such risks from happening," Wang was quoted as saying.
Under China's commercial banks law passed in 1995, presidents of branch banks can only operate within the limits of the certificates and are forbidden from other business.
The bank would keep a close eye on the performance of each branch and certificates would be valid for one year, Wang said.

China's bank branches have amassed greater power in recent years along with decentralisation and deepening of economic reform, and official media has reported increasing corruption and mismanagement in bank branches.
